_doc: Per-holding identity rulings by Drew. conform-holdings-to-catalog SCOPE=rulings applies ONLY these: the holding's current hobbyiqCardId must equal `from`, the `to` row must exist in card_catalog, and both cardId and hobbyiqCardId are set to `to` (one identity). A product-changing move is what the bot refuses (CF-A-HOLDING-NEVER-ADOPTS-A-VENDOR-ROW); a ruling is the human saying so.

rulings.note: Ohtani HMT-1 is the Topps Chrome Update card
CPA-BA ships in the Bowman release; Bowman Chrome is the later product
CPA-FA ships in the Bowman release
2018 Topps Chrome #150 Refractor, pitching (the standard Refractor); the #9 came from PSA 9
